Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Delay Sign-In After Pet Selection: Move the sign-in prompt to after pet customization and adoption certificate creation so users build an emotional bond before creating an account. (why: Sign-in conversion is low (72.9%) with a fast 3s median time, indicating immediate friction. 8 support emails mention missing/reset pets after signing in.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Fast-Track Preset Pet Selection Flow: Add an instant adoption choice card for pre-made pets to skip custom photo processing errors and lengthy wait times. (why: Adoption conversion is only 60.9% (mean time 1017s) and 3 support emails report custom pet generation errors or bad results.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Account Cloud Backup Assurance Hint: Display explicit reassurance copy below sign-in explaining that account creation prevents loss of pet progress across sessions. (why: The single largest support category (8 emails) concerns pets missing or reset after signing back in.)
3: [adoption, wait_info] Photo Quality Guidance & Validation Info: Provide clear photo upload tips and quality feedback on the upload screen to ensure high quality pet generation. (why: 3 support messages complain that custom pet generation fails or looks wrong, driving down adoption completion (60.9%).)

scores.note: Delaying sign-in leverages emotional attachment to reduce early friction.
Presets bypass long photo processing times and generation failures.
Reassurance copy addresses pet loss concerns with trivial copy changes.
Photo upload guidance reduces generation errors at the bottleneck step.
